title: Legal Counsel, AI Governance
description: NVIDIA is looking for an attorney to join our Legal team as Legal Counsel, AI Governance, helping to support and drive our AI-related compliance functions. You will help scale NVIDIA’s AI governance program and provide counsel on emerging AI regulation, transparency, and safety requirements. You will report directly to the VP of Trustworthy AI in our Legal Department and work closely with the entire legal team, as well as colleagues in security, research, and product. Our highly respected legal team provides innovative solutions and practical guidance that help make NVIDIA the world leader in AI and accelerated computing. As AI transforms every industry, from AI factories and frontier models to robotics and autonomous vehicles, we help ensure NVIDIA’s technology is developed and deployed responsibly and in step with a fast-changing legal landscape. You will be asked to continuously learn and develop your legal skills, and you will be responsible for providing legal support on a wide variety of issues. We value partnership, teamwork, and creative thinking. What you’ll be doing: Advising research and product teams on regulatory requirements, transparency obligations, and development standards. Helping build and run compliance programs for AI technologies under global and state frameworks. Drafting and reviewing NVIDIA’s AI frameworks, transparency reports, and other public disclosures. Supporting regulator outreach, standards-body participation, and industry engagement on AI governance. What we need to see: J.D. degree with a record of strong academic performance. 2+ years of relevant legal experience in technology regulation, privacy, data governance, or AI, gained at a law firm, in-house, or in government. Working knowledge of AI regulation and a genuine interest in how AI technologies are developed and governed. A license to practice law in California and a willingness to work out of our Santa Clara headquarters. Extraordinary communication and project management skills, including writing, presentation, organizational abilities, and attention to detail. Ways to stand out from the crowd: In-house experience advising on AI, privacy, or technology regulatory compliance, ideally in the high-tech industry. Technical familiarity with machine learning, AI model development, computer systems, or programming. Familiarity with intellectual property, privacy, and cybersecurity topics as they relate to AI. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 232,000 USD – 368,000 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 8, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Associate, Compliance Model Governance
description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Associate, Compliance Model Governance on the Compliance team, you'll own quantitative testing, monitoring, and data quality for the AI and statistical models that power Coinbase's financial crime compliance programs, including transaction monitoring models. You'll sit between Compliance, Data Science, and Engineering, designing the tests, building the pipelines and dashboards that track model health, and ensuring every model in production is defensible to Internal Audit and regulators. What you'll do: Design and execute quantitative testing for AI and ML models before and after launch, including input data quality testing, variance and stability testing, and performance testing for agentic and LLM-based systems, producing documentation that holds up to independent model validation and regulatory examination. Build and maintain monitoring pipelines and dashboards that track model inputs, outputs, and downstream outcomes (e.g., SAR performance metrics), applying statistical tests to detect drift and degradation and delivering clear health readouts to model owners and Compliance leadership. Own data lineage for compliance-critical data elements, designing data quality checks that feed Compliance's data quality control framework and partnering with Engineering to trace data from source systems to control consumption. Write production-quality SQL and Python pipelines, diagnosing and fixing pipeline bugs and leading data migrations that support external regulatory reporting. Build detective monitoring scenarios that test whether compliance controls are working, writing and validating the underlying SQL logic. Prepare testing evidence, model documentation, and walkthroughs for Internal Audit, model validators, and regulators, responding to findings and tracking remediation to closure. Required Skills and Experience: 4+ years of experience in data science, model risk, quantitative analytics, or data engineering, ideally in financial services, fintech, or another regulated setting. Strong grounding in applied statistics (hypothesis testing, drift and stability measures, sampling, confidence intervals) with hands-on experience evaluating ML models, including testing LLM-based or agentic systems (e.g., accuracy against human-reviewed samples, variance across runs, input and payload monitoring). Advanced SQL and Python skills with experience building monitoring dashboards and working in cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake or Databricks), including data lineage tracing and data quality rule design. Demonstrated ability to write testing and model documentation that withstands independent review, and to communicate technical results clearly to non-technical compliance stakeholders and auditors. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)).    Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $148,835 — $175,100 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice . title: AI Risk Oversight, Director
description: About this role BlackRock is one of the world’s leading asset management firms, committed to helping investors build better financial futures. We bring together the best of technology and investment expertise to deliver innovative solutions across markets and geographies. Risk management is central to our mission, and data and technology are among our most important assets, serving as key differentiators for both the firm and our Aladdin business. Business Overview Our Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks. The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function within RQA oversees risks that directly impact the corporate entity, including operational, technology, third party, model, and data risk, rather than the fiduciary risks assumed by funds and clients. As a second line of defense function, our mission is to ensure senior management has defined and implemented effective risk management controls that protect our clients and our firm, while supporting the achievement of firm-wide business goals within our risk tolerance. RQA is committed to investing in our people to build both individual capability and a strong, collaborative team, within a culture of inclusion that encourages teamwork, innovation, and the development of future leaders. The Opportunity Artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming embedded across BlackRock’s technology, investment, operating and client-facing platforms. As AI capabilities move from experimentation into production, the firm must manage not only the risks inherent in models, but also the broader ecosystem through which AI is built, accessed, deployed and operated. We are seeking a Director to lead AI Risk Oversight within Enterprise Risk Management . This role will provide independent oversight and challenge across the end-to-end AI lifecycle, focusing on how AI systems are built and governed, where models and AI services operate, how they access firm data and systems, and how they are safely deployed into production. The successful candidate will bring together risk considerations that span traditional organizational boundaries. This includes AI model (including agentic AI) and deployment risks, AI infrastructure and architecture, access management, third-party party enablement and native AI usage, cybersecurity dependencies, production monitoring, and AI compute and inference risk . This individual will partner closely with Model Risk Management, Technology and Cyber Risk, Third Party Risk, Information Security, Engineering and first line AI owners to establish a holistic view of AI risk across the firm. The role requires someone who understands both the technical architecture supporting modern AI systems and the risk and governance frameworks required to deploy them safely at enterprise scale. Key Responsibilities AI Risk Oversight Provide independent oversight, review, and challenge of AI risk across the firm, assessing how AI capabilities are designed, governed, implemented, deployed and monitored, and holding first line owners accountable for managing risks within the firm’s risk tolerance. AI Architecture, Infrastructure and Deployment Risk Assess the technology architecture and operating environment supporting AI, including model and data pipelines, access and entitlements, production deployment, cloud and compute infrastructure, GPU utilization and cybersecurity dependencies, ensuring appropriate controls exist as AI moves from development into production. Model Behavior and Production Risk Oversee risks arising from AI models operating in production, including human oversight and controls around generative and agentic AI, partnering closely with Model Risk Management to provide complementary oversight beyond traditional model risk. Third-Party Enablement and AI Risks Partner with Third Party Risk to assess end-to-end risks associated with external AI models, platforms and infrastructure, including vendor dependencies, data and system access, model changes, cloud and compute concentration, and the controls governing third-party AI from selection through production deployment. AI Incidents and Operating Events Provide independent oversight of AI-related incidents and control issues, challenging root cause analysis and remediation, identifying systemic or emerging themes, and ensuring material risks and unresolved issues are appropriately escalated. Metrics, Risk Indicators and Reporting Develop an enterprise view of AI risk through meaningful metrics, risk indicators and senior-level reporting, translating technical risks across models, deployments, infrastructure, third parties and controls into clear assessments of residual risk for senior management, committees and boards. Governance and Stakeholder Engagement Serve as a senior RQA leader connecting AI risk across Model Risk Management, Technology and Cyber Risk, Third Party Risk, Data Risk, Legal & Compliance, Privacy and business technology

title: Vice President, Global Affairs
description: Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. About Global Affairs at Okta: Okta’s Global Affairs organization is a newly consolidated, highly strategic function designed to drive business growth, navigate and shape regulatory landscapes, and advance our mission to build a more secure, inclusive, and sustainable world. Reporting directly to the Chief Legal Officer, this unified Global Affairs team brings together Government Affairs, Sustainability & Responsible Technology, and Social Impact & Nonprofit Go-To-Market (Okta for Good).  We operate at the critical intersection of public policy, trust, commercial strategy, and social good. Together, this team ensures Okta meets and promotes rigorous AI governance, sustainability, and compliance requirements of our largest enterprise and public sector customers, while advocating for public policy that advances Okta’s business and maintaining Okta’s strong brand reputation and cultural impact.  Role Overview: We are seeking a Vice President of Global Affairs: a commercially-minded executive with a strong background in government affairs and public policy, coupled with a demonstrated ability to champion a corporate impact function. The ideal candidate is a strategic operator, a compelling storyteller, passionate about technology’s ability to lift communities, and a seasoned leader capable of navigating complex ecosystems—from public sector leaders and regulators to enterprise customers and global nonprofit partners. This leader will report directly to the Chief Legal Officer and serve as a vital bridge between Okta’s legal and compliance frameworks, our responsible stewardship programs and our Go-To-Market (GTM) machinery. You will provide executive-level air cover for our durable business growth and success while relying on highly seasoned, domain-expert leaders to run the day-to-day operations of the team. You will be a thoughtful, courageous and publicly vocal proponent of Okta’s Global Affairs efforts. This leader will oversee three critical pillars of Okta's business: Government Affairs & Public Sector Growth Lead Okta’s global Government Affairs strategy, navigating and shaping regulatory environments and advancing Okta’s public policy priorities through thought leadership and advocacy. Partner directly with Okta’s GTM and public sector sales leaders to accelerate pipeline and unlock new commercial opportunities. Help expand Okta’s thought leadership in critical technology domains, helping us fulfill our vision to free everyone to safely use any technology. Expand the capacity and reach of the Government Affairs function by leveraging cross-trained talent across the Global Affairs organization. Sustainability & Responsible Technology Oversee Okta’s sustainability strategy, disclosures, and compliance with escalating customer and regulatory requirements (including protecting and accelerating deal flow). Drive the successful reset and Board approval of Okta’s Science-Based Targets for emissions reductions. Champion a robust, centralized Responsible AI governance program across the business and our customers. Social Impact & Okta for Good Oversee Okta’s nonprofit business and product donation commitment, partnering with GTM to drive growth while balancing social impact. Oversee Okta’s donor-advised fund, including the execution of our current $50M philanthropic commitment and the development of a future funding strategy. Champion Okta’s award-winning culture of giving, sustaining high employee engagement and brand value. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Leadership Set a unified, bold strategy for Global Affairs that directly supports Okta’s commercial growth in large enterprise and public sector markets. Serve as an executive champion for trust, responsible AI, and mission-aligned growth. Represent Okta with senior external stakeholders, including government officials, regulators, enterprise customers, nonprofit partners, and investors. Present vision and operations to employees, executives and board members on an ongoing basis. Go-To-Market (GTM) Integration Operate a powerful overlay model across GTM to drive revenue via Okta’s compliance readiness, sustainability commitments, and nonprofit product offerings. Ensure Okta is positioned as a trusted partner to the public sector and our most highly regulated customers. title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
description: Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten. Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten. Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk. Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken. Jouw rol Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten. Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties. Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren. Wat je doet Data- en AI-governance Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI. Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming. Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen. Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps. Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten. Data quality, metadata & AI Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage. Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden. Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen. Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren. Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act. Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen. Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten. Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier. Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren. Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team. Samenwerking & ontwikkeling Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is. Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening. Wat jij meebrengt Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy. Kennis van data governance, data quality, data stewardship en governanceprocessen. Ervaring met het uitvoeren van analyses, begeleiden van workshops of adviseren van stakeholders. Begrip van data-architectuur, datamodellering en de samenwerking tussen business en IT. Interesse in AI-governance en het verantwoord toepassen van AI binnen organisaties. Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en onderzoekt graag hoe het slimmer kan. Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet wanneer je collega's moet betrekken. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen. Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen Ervaring met maturity assessments, governance operating models of het opstellen van RACI's. Kennis van DAMA-DMBOK of een CDMP-certificering, of de ambitie om deze te behalen. Ervaring met datacatalogustools zoals Microsoft Purview, Collibra of Alation. Kennis van metadata, data lineage en data quality frameworks. Kennis van Responsible AI, de EU AI Act of data-readiness voor AI. Over ons team Je komt terecht in een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie collega's. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het echte probleem van de klant. Van daaruit ontwikkelen we roadmaps en helpen we bij de implementatie. We werken aan data- en AI-governance, datastrategie, change management en datakwaliteit. Daarbij onderzoeken we continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken. Ontwikkeling staat voorop. We delen kennis, proberen nieuwe werkwijzen uit en leren van elkaar. Heb je een andere achtergrond binnen datamanagement? Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert. Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? Een salaris van €5.400,- tot €6.600,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris; 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen; €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen; Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden; Goede pensioenregeling; Doorgroeimogelijkheden; Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team. Zullen we kennismaken? Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien. Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase. Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Product Manager
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.   About the Role Veeam is looking for a high-agency, hands-on Principal Product Manager to help define what data and AI trust looks like in the agentic era. AI is a generational discontinuity: autonomous agents now read, modify, and delete enterprise data at machine speed, and the AI factories behind them increasingly run as stateful, cloud-native workloads on Kubernetes — from AI pipelines and model artifacts to the vector databases powering RAG. The infrastructure to deploy AI exists; the infrastructure to trust it is still being built. As data resilience, data security, and AI governance converge on the Veeam DataAI Command Platform, we need a builder who can take ideas from 0 to 1 at that intersection. You’ll join a friendly, fast-moving team of builders who win together and move fast. This is a senior individual contributor role — there are no direct reports, and your impact comes from what you build, ship, and influence, not from the size of an org chart. You’ll thrive here if you love building and are energized by ambiguity. What You’ll Do Bridge data resilience, security, and AI. Connect the dots between data resilience, data security posture, and AI governance — identifying where they converge and defining products that keep customers resilient, secure, and AI-ready. Seize the agentic AI opportunity. Shape new use cases for protecting and securing AI workloads — especially in Kubernetes environments — from detecting risky agent activity to undoing AI mistakes with precise, clean, verified recovery. Roll up your sleeves with engineering. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with globally distributed development teams on use-case architecture and platform hardening — from authentication and logging to secrets management — and tease out the minimum viable product. Champion security and compliance as deal accelerators. Partner cross-functionally to triage security findings into fixable work and drive compliance (e.g., SOC 2, STIG, NIST, VPAT) that unblocks regulated and public-sector deals. Own the “why.” Articulate why we are building what we’re building, and bring engineers, customers, and leadership along once the merits are clear. Educate customers and the field. Partner with sales and lead customers to articulate and validate the value proposition, build compelling demos and proofs of concept, and evangelize at analyst and community events. Innovate in the eyes of the customer. Use what you learn from customers to lead the development roadmap iteratively — ship, learn, and refine in tight loops so every release reflects real-world needs. Take initiatives from 0 → 1. title: Internal Audit - Lead (Remote in So. Cal.)
description: FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential! The Opportunity Join our top-notch risk and assurance team within a global, fast-growing and progressive data analytics and cutting-edge AI oriented software company. If you’re eager to feel empowered and apply your creativity and experience in a way that adds value and serves to mitigate business risks across the enterprise, this is the opportunity for you. This is a hands-on lead role. You will own the IT audit coverage for a defined portfolio of FICO’s financial applications, cloud platforms and security tooling — running engagements end to end, setting the testing approach, and raising the bar on how we use data, automation and AI to get assurance. What You’ll Contribute Lead IT audit engagements end to end with limited supervision — scoping and risk assessment, walkthroughs, design and operating effectiveness testing, issue development, and remediation validation. Own the Sarbanes-Oxley Section 404 (SOX 404) IT general controls program for an assigned portfolio of in-scope financial applications and supporting infrastructure, spanning access to programs and data, change management, program development, and IT operations. Test IT application controls, key reports, interfaces and system-generated data supporting financial reporting across our ERP and other in-scope financial applications. Perform annual and ad-hoc segregation of duties (SoD) analysis. This is data-driven work: extracting role and entitlement data from source systems, normalizing and deduplicating it, applying and maintaining a conflict ruleset, identifying conflicting access combinations and privileged access exceptions, and working with process owners to validate, justify or remediate what surfaces. A standing goal for this role is to automate the extraction, normalization and comparison steps so the analysis becomes a repeatable, monitorable process rather than a once-a-year manual exercise. Audit identity and access management across the enterprise — directory services, enterprise single sign-on, identity governance and access certification platforms, and privileged access and secrets management tooling (password vaults and safes) — covering joiner/mover/leaver provisioning, privileged access, and periodic user access reviews. Evaluate change and release management controls across modern DevOps toolchains — Git-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, and IT service management platforms such as Jira and ServiceNow — including automated approvals and separation of duties between development and production. Assess controls over cloud infrastructure and enterprise data platforms, covering configuration, encryption, logging and monitoring, and data pipeline integrity. Perform cybersecurity and cloud security assessments across FICO’s SaaS product environments that hold sensitive client data. Support third-party risk and service organization report reviews — evaluating SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports, transcribing and mapping complementary user entity controls (CUECs) to FICO controls, and assessing subservice organization coverage and bridge letters. Contribute to emerging-risk coverage as FICO’s use of AI expands, including AI and model governance controls evaluated against frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001. Apply data analytics and AI-assisted tooling to audit work — scripted population extraction, full-population testing where practical, and automated continuous monitoring — rather than defaulting to manual sampling. Prepare clear, well-supported work papers; summarize findings and review them with the Chief Audit Executive and/or the Senior Manager, IT Risk & Assurance. Act as the liaison between our external auditors and internal stakeholders across a wide variety of topics and projects. This means coordinating IT scoping and walkthroughs, owning evidence and PBC requests end to end, supporting reliance discussions on internal audit work, translating external auditor expectations into practical asks for system and process owners, and tracking open items through to closure so neither side is left waiting. Partner with IT, Engineering, Security, Finance and business process owners so that population and sample requests are identified, communicated and retrieved efficiently. Drive improvement of FICO’s internal control structure through practical control design and process enhancement recommendations. Coach and review the work of junior auditors and co-sourced resources, and help maintain testing standards, templates and documentation quality across the team. Proactively keep leadership informed of progress, control weaknesses and audit findings; meet established deadlines while maintaining confidentiality when dealing with sensitive information and situations. About the Role: Gusto is looking for a senior, technically minded workforce management planner who can design and scale AI-powered forecasting and capacity planning systems. You will report into the Planning People Empower and play a leading role in shaping how AI is adopted across forecasting, scheduling, and intraday operations. This role is equal parts strategic design and hands-on execution: you'll build the frameworks, pipelines, and governance structures that elevate WFM from reactive to predictive. Connect AI-generated insights to operational decisions across staffing, scheduling, and capacity planning. Design scalable AI-enabled WFM workflows across forecasting, scheduling, and intraday functions. Evaluate and recommend process enhancements to boost efficiency and capacity utilization.
